notes: BER = 1E-12 @ 1.25 Gbps, PRBS7, NRZ for TX optical power and RX sensitivity. RX sensitivity note requires TX signal ER greater than 8 dB. Minimum TX optical power can be factory-set higher (e.g. -6 dBm). Link distance 550 m per IEEE 802.3z table; 500 m Fibre Channel ANSI X3.297; Table A lists 850 m typical for LxK-ST11xx with standard fiber and nominal connector losses. Supply voltage 3.135–3.465 V, Icc max 300 mA (general); TX Icc 55–75 mA, RX Icc 70–120 mA. Stratos (now Cinch Connectivity Solutions). Fiber pigtail option supports LC, SC, FC, ST and others.
